prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached Japanese beach cleanup design proposal board. Preserve the exact three bins, their blue/yellow/coral colors, pictograms, glossy rounded painted style, all headers, category titles, background and footer. Make ONLY the following changes in the lower item rows:
1. MOVE the existing BLUE COILED ROPE, with its label "ロープ", out of the LEFT "プラスチック" panel into the RIGHT "もえるゴミ" panel. Keep the rope's same blue color, twisted texture, loose coil and ends. It must appear exactly ONCE, under burnable trash, not under plastic.
2. LEFT lower panel now contains exactly TWO items: the original plastic bottle labeled "ペットボトル" and the original shopping bag labeled "ビニールぶくろ". Center and space them neatly.
3. RIGHT lower panel now contains exactly THREE items, left to right: original twig labeled "きのえだ", redesigned paper labeled "かみくず", original blue rope labeled "ロープ". Scale these three consistently to fit within their panel, entire silhouettes clear with comfortable spacing; keep all three labels legible below the respective items.
4. REDESIGN ONLY the paper illustration. Remove the old angular faceted ball that resembles a rock or popcorn. Draw a recognizable discarded piece of IVORY NOTEBOOK PAPER loosely scrunched and folded, with one broad visible face bearing THREE or FOUR delicate pale-aqua horizontal ruled lines, soft curled corners, a small irregular torn edge, and a few large gentle creases. An asymmetrical rounded partly-open paper wad, not a flat pristine sheet and not a dense spherical mass. Warm peach shadows and soft cream highlights, a simple cute readable silhouette in the same painted 2.5D style. NO face, eyes, stars, written words or letters. At small size it should immediately read as paper.
MIDDLE panel remains exactly the original can and glass bottle, unchanged. There are exactly SEVEN litter items total, grouped TWO / TWO / THREE. Preserve all remaining layout and typography. This is a design proposal, not an application screenshot.
